title: Context-personalized GPT-4 Python exercises
summary: Students choose or receive themes and solve supplementary Python exercises generated by GPT-4 in an elective introductory course. The system presents tailored problems for hands-on practice, and students rate exercise quality and report whether they solved each task.

sources.title: Evaluating Contextually Personalized Programming Exercises Created with Generative AI
sources.evidence_quote: This article reports on a user study conducted in an elective introductory programming course that included contextually personalized programming exercises created with GPT-4.
